integrity.evidence: Elementary free-face collapse and integral Alexander duality, with a standalone finite graph verifier.
integrity.external_validation: No independent audit or validation has been performed.

scientific_limitations: The homotopy classification of the original complex is restricted to n at least eight, and also n equal to six; only integral homology is claimed for n equal to seven.
No equivariance, shellability, canonical homotopy equivalence, or sharp girth boundary is claimed.
Finite checks are not infinite-order proofs; unindexed prior equivalents remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Four-cut homotopy of graphs without cycles of length at most five
